Granola - Old Recipe
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 12:36am

Ingredients




5 cups Oatmeal, not instant
1 cup Cashews, (or almonds) sliced
1 cup Sesame seeds, unrefined
1 cup Shredded coconut meat
1 cup Soy flour
1 cup Powdered milk, not instant
1 cup Wheat germ
1 cup Sunflower seeds
1 cup Honey
1 cup Sesame oil, or vegetable oil

Preparation

1 Combine all dry ingredients in a large Dutch oven. In a separate utensil combine honey and oil. Combine two sets of ingredients and spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 300 degrees for 20 minutes or until slightly brown. Or, to cook large amount - place in 200 degree oven and cook for 1 hour, stirring about every 25 minutes. Turn oven off and leave cereal in for another hour or two.
